scope: Distributed residential and street lighting throughout the existing finite neighbourhood. No spatial expansion or new disk model.

visualCorrections: Added rear window light to every new house so the back of a residential row also reads as occupied.
Removed the overly tight default light-field ground rectangle, retaining feathered courtyard wall bounds.
Added lamps to the north perimeter centre and original bookshop rear-lane gaps.
Extended roadside post feet into existing soil while preserving pedestrian clearance.
limitations: Lighting is distributed across all developed zones, with natural dark intervals; this is not uniform illumination of every metre of road or all distant landscape.
The broad light field approximates local diffuse illumination. Six short-range unshadowed point lights add nearby response; no shadowed global-illumination solver or new interior rooms were added.
The original dusk sky, source bookshop lighting, scene geometry and all prior versions remain intact.
